headlines.title: Baltic dry bulk freight index hits six-week low on weaker rates
headlines.content_summary: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk freight index dropped to its lowest point in more than six weeks on Thursday as declining capesize rates offset increases in the panamax and supramax segments. headlines.title: Savannah achieves record container volumes in September
headlines.content_summary: The Port of Savannah achieved a record September for container volumes, moving 504,015 twenty-foot equivalent container units last month, an increase of 3.7 percent compared to September 2025.
